_meta.description: Official monthly fuel prices in South Africa, one record per monthly adjustment.
_meta.publisher: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR)
_meta.units: South African cents per litre, exactly as printed by the DMPR

zones.inland: Zone 9C, Gauteng: the inland reference price the DMPR uses in its own history tables

price_types.diesel500ppm: Wholesale list price, diesel 0.05% sulphur (500 ppm)
price_types.diesel50ppm: Wholesale list price, diesel 0.005% sulphur (50 ppm)

_meta.terms: DMPR material may be reproduced if it is accurate, not used for financial or commercial gain, not misleading, and credited to the DMPR with its website address (https://www.dmpr.gov.za/Terms-Conditions).
_meta.built_by: scripts/fuel/build_prices.py from the files in sources/releases/fuel/ (not committed)
_meta.null_values: null means no file SA Data Hub holds gives that price for that month

adjustments.note: The file's header says 2021-01-05. The year is a typo in the file: it was published for 2022-01.

source.document: February 2026 Petrol Regulations and Diesel wholesale prices (PDF). Paraffin from History of Fuel Prices November 2026

adjustments.note: The DMPR published PDFs, not a spreadsheet, for February 2026. Petrol and diesel were typed from the zone 1A and 9C rows of those PDFs. Paraffin was typed from the DMPR's History of Fuel Prices table in the November 2026 pack.
